image_description: A full suit of polished steel plate armor displayed against a dark red background. The armor includes a helmet with horizontal visor slits, a breastplate with fluted decoration, pauldrons (shoulder armor) with circular decorative elements, articulated arm defenses (rerebraces and vambraces), and a fauld (waist armor) with tassets. The armor is highly reflective and shows detailed craftsmanship.
